newsitem.title: USA: Trump Hotels forms Trump Castle venture.
newsitem.headline: Trump Hotels forms Trump Castle venture.

text.p: Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Inc said Monday it signed a letter of intent to form a partnership with Colony Capital Inc which will invest $125 million to fund the expansion and retheming of Trump's Castle.

Colony Capital, a real estate investment firm based in Los Angeles, will make the investment through the purchase of a 51 percent equity interest in Trump's Castle, Trump Hotels said. Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Holdings LP will retain a 49 percent interest in Trump's Castle and will continue to manage the property.
The current Trump's Castle debt of $314 million will be deconsolidated from Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts' balance sheet upon completion of the transaction.

"We plan to use the proceeds of this transaction to provide the necessary resources to continue the retheming to Trump Marina, which we have already begun, and to more than double our room base from 728 to 1,500.
"This strategic transaction strengthens our balance sheet and provides for future benefits, which further our goal of increasing long-term shareholder value," Trump Hotels said.
Completion of the transaction is subject to, among other things, the execution of definitive agreements and the receipt of certain consents and approvals.

The soon to be Trump Marina "is the only casino hotel located on (Atlantic City's) marina waterfront, highlighted by its 645 slip marina, the East Coast's largest," the company added. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
